title: Is Microsoft Stock Overvalued At 28x Earnings?
summary: Microsoft (MSFT) runs the highest operating margin in its peer group and grows revenue faster than every rival there but one. Over the past twelve months its stock returned -0.5%, against 18.5% for the S&P 500 (SPY). At about $491.65 a share, it trades at 27.8 times earnings, second-richest in the group. Microsoft ranks first on profitability and fourth on the return, a gap worth explaining.

title: Is CRM Stock Getting Riskier As It Gets More Profitable?
summary: Salesforce (CRM) shares have remained essentially flat over the past twelve months, slipping 2.3% and lagging the broader market by roughly 20 percentage points. If you own it, the live question is whether this is a riskier company than the one you bought.
